description.value:
House-rule proposal (not yet agreed with the player). When you use Fey Step, its rider follows your current season instead of a freely chosen one. With the ring worn that is always Winter.

Winter. One creature of your choice within 5 feet makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

Automated: using Fey Step posts a chat card showing your current season and the Winter rider with your save DC.
